name: Effective VC Radius of Cube with Apex
proof: Every coordinate is effective and every singleton is shattered. For each $i\in[n]$, the trace on $\{\star,i\}$ realizes $00,01,10$ but not $11$, because the apex is zero at $i$ and every base-cube concept is zero at $\star$. Thus not every effective pair is shattered, so the value is one.
